HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.
   D. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.
   B. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Linguistic groups in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Linguistic groups in Kenya.
   C. Say Linguistic groups in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Linguistic groups in Kenya as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   B. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.
   C. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.
   C. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

9. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.
   C. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Elections in Kenya as rumours only.

10. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

11. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.
   B. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.
   D. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Equality and Non-Discrimination Page 16 of 75 1 STRAND 1.0: THEMES IN KENYAN HIS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Equity and non- discrimination and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to History and Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Linguistic groups in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. C — Nairobi

2. B — Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. B — Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. A — Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. D — Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. A — Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. D — Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. B — Plan income and spending wisely

9. C — Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. A — Explain symbols used on a map

11. D — Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. C — Obeying laws and caring for public property

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to History and Citizenship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Linguistic groups in Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
